subject.title: fix(qa): repair WhatsApp live scenario regressions

question: Does the WhatsApp/QA owner approve landing this final-head QA-harness change after confirming its live WhatsApp fleet evidence against the current merge result?
rationale: The PR is authored by a repository member and carries the protected maintainer label; the remaining gate is operational ownership confirmation, not a mechanical patch defect.

options.title: Confirm and merge

options.title: Request narrower evidence
options.body: Ask for an exact-final-head live run or focused diagnostic if the owner cannot confirm the reported fleet result after refresh.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge
